brief: Two-storey frame granary about 24 ft by 36 ft with a gable roof of weathered grey diamond shingles and a long shed-roofed lean-to added on the east side, open at the end for machinery. The north and west walls are clad in pale grey-blue pressed-metal sheets stamped in a brick pattern, with rust blooms, while the rest is silvered vertical and horizontal board siding on a limestone foundation. A big sliding door hangs off a sagging timber frame on the south end; small plank doors and a steel windmill stand nearby in the tall grass. (Granary with pressed-metal siding; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed and nearest wall is board_and_batten.)
